title: Feel the wave
text: Great experience great crew. Nice people. No Sun set but you know what… That’s Life. Very recommended
author: Luc_B

title: Just a lovely experience....
text: Just a lovely experience. Kids’ favourite for the whole vacation. Nice crew. Amazing views. Weather was fantastic.
author: Tatyana_W

title: Fantastic trip
text: This was a last-minute trip that we booked and we were so happy that we did. I had broken my shoulder and elbow prior to going  my cruise. I did not go to the doctor. I proceeded to go on my cruise. The crew was told that I may have broken my shoulder, but I wanted to go in the water. I asked them if they thought I would be able to get back into the ship and they guaranteed that they would help me if I couldn’t. This was the best way to end our vacation. Swimming in the water in the Mediterranean. It absolutely helped my shoulder and put us in such a calm state of mind. Everyone was so helpful
author: B8402ILkellyh

title: Great afternoon boat ride.
text: Wonderfully relaxing experience. The weather was perfect, but no wind so no sails.  Don’t expect too much from the tapas or drinks.   Sangria was included and there were olives, cheese, egg/potato tapa, salami and some bread sticks.  Besides the weather, the crew were first rate.  Very chill and nice.  Great overall experience would recommend.  Nice views of Barcelona from the Mediterranean and nice tour of the harbor.  Very peaceful.
author: Tim_D

title: Beautiful
text: It was a great cruise on a Beautiful Day in Barcelona. The crew was great and there were only 18 of us on the catamaran.
author: Jeff_E

title: Wonderful boat ride
text: The sailor and his friend both spoke in English. They were very friendly and offered drinks snd Tapas as part of the ride. We were able to go out to the front of the boat as well as other areas during the boat ride.
author: Sneaha_O

title: Happy sailor
text: This was a fun experience. Our captain and his crew mate were welcoming, friendly and informative. The trip had to be adjusted due to high seas, but felt like we still got a good few from the harbor. I did feel like the tapas was a little sparse, but you could drink as much as you wanted. Thought maybe because there were only 6 passengers when they had expected 25. We appreciated that they still ran despite the low numbers. Would book again and would recommend.
author: Christine_H

title: Great experience, yummy...
text: Great experience, yummy drinks and food. Our captains were entertaining and worked hard to make the experience one to remember. We even saw some dolphins! Definitely worth it.
author: Cassidy_L

title: Nice
text: Very nice trip, captain and his colleage was great
author: dominik_630

title: Really friendly crew...
text: Really friendly crew takes care of the food, drink, and sailing. There are 30 minutes allotted to swimming if you're wanting to do that. This was early September and a lot of folks jumped in.
author: Michael_C
